L9·N11928unmasked layer
This neuron gives its strongest (but small) positive responses to ordinary function/filler tokens — " the", commas, colons, spaces and digits — when they sit inside boilerplate/metadata-style text (product-listing blurbs, "Uploaded Date:", posted-on dates, bibliographic titles), and is suppressed on those very same tokens in flowing narrative prose, so it appears to be a context-flavor (catalog/metadata vs. prose) signal read off generic tokens rather than a specific-token detector.
